provenance.note: Generic layout from the standard Humidifier service (on / fan-level at piids 1/2) plus the Environment-service humidity reading many models expose at siid 3 piid 1; target-humidity and water level layouts vary more by model and are not claimed.

source: MIoT-Spec standard Humidifier service definition for the humidifier device type, as published in the MIoT specification (miot-spec.org): the device's main service is siid 2. The humidity reading follows the Environment service commonly exposed as siid 3 (relative-humidity at piid 1).
